From: Sara Jensen <sara.jensen@clearwelllabs.com>

Cc: procurement@clearwelllabs.com
Date: 2025-12-09T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Redwood DPA: CCPA/CPRA role and subprocessor evidence

Hi Jordan,

Thanks for the demo last week. As part of our legal review for Clearwell Labs we need to confirm a few items in the DPA / US addendum before we can proceed with procurement:

- Can Redwood confirm it will be designated as a "service provider" (i.e., CCPA/CPRA service provider / operator) rather than a business/processor for our account? We want the handling to reflect limited-use obligations.
- Please provide an up-to-date subprocessor list and SOC 2 attestation (or equivalent).
- We need a high-level dataflow diagram showing telemetry/usage logs vs. customer content, and whether any telemetry is considered "sale".
- For CCPA compliance we also need an onshore-fallback plan or description of controls for any non-US subprocessors.
- Deletion SLA question: can Redwood honor a 30-day deletion window for end-customer deletion requests (excluding retention required for backups/ops)?

If you can share these items and a proposed redline of the addendum we can move to procurement. Would like to schedule a short call if needed.

Best,
Sara Jensen
Sr. Counsel, Privacy & Security
Clearwell Labs

Attachments: none (please attach evidence)

Hi Sara — thanks for the clear list. Quick answers up front: Redwood confirms we will accept designation as a CCPA/CPRA "service provider" (limited-use obligations) for Clearwell Labs under the addendum language you shared.

We’ll produce an evidence bundle with: SOC 2 (latest report), the current subprocessor roster, a redlined addendum draft (we'll accept SP language with a couple clarifying edits), and a simplified dataflow diagram separating customer content from telemetry. For non-US subprocessors we have an onshore-fallback description and contractual controls — we'll include that. Regarding deletion SLA: 30 days is our standard for primary data; we'll confirm behavior for backups in the pack.

I uploaded a provisional evidence folder here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2bClearwell-Evidence (draft items).

Propose a 30-minute call to walk through the packet and any redline items — I’m available 2025-12-10 between 09:00-11:00 PT or 2025-12-11 14:00-16:00 PT. If one of those works I’ll lock it in.

Quick note: we will not treat telemetry as a "sale"; telemetry is used for service reliability and product improvement and is covered by the limited-use commitments in the addendum. The dataflow will show telemetry aggregated/non-identifying where applicable.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
